horizon_note: A row whose effective_from equals horizon_start was in force before Nyabo's coverage horizon; its legal in-force date is not asserted. Only the Law on Accounting rows carry the stated in-force date (2016-01-01, reference §1.1).
verified_means: A human compared the value with the primary legal text: `source_text` names the instrument, `article` the article, `source_url` a legalinfo.mn / parliament.mn page, and docs/mn-rules-reference.md states the value without a VERIFY flag. status_means: active = value may be used; pending = value is null and the engine raises PendingRuleError on any lookup landing on the row (a known change whose text is not encoded yet). A key with no row on a date raises MissingRuleError. Neither ever falls back to another period.
